description: Implementation of NativeJS functionality including application lifecycle management, threading, and rendering control within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace.

classes.name: NativeJSImplementation
classes.description: Class implementing native JavaScript application management within the plugin, handling initialization, execution, and termination.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the renderer with a specified Wayland display, starting a thread for rendering.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources and stops the renderer thread.

methods.name: CreateApplication
methods.description: Creates a new application with specified options and returns its ID.

methods.name: RunApplication
methods.description: Runs an application with a given ID and URL.

methods.name: RunJavaScript
methods.description: Executes JavaScript code in the context of a specified application ID.

methods.name: GetApplications
methods.description: Retrieves the list of current applications.

methods.name: TerminateApplication
methods.description: Terminates the application with the specified ID.
